summary: Nexalin Technology filed an 8-K on August 21, 2026 disclosing a Note Purchase Agreement with an institutional investor. The investor bought a $1,170,000 unsecured promissory note, including a $150,000 original issue discount and $20,000 expense reimbursement, for $1,000,000 gross proceeds. The note matures six months after funding, bears no interest absent default, and is prepayable without penalty. Mandatory prepayment of up to 20% of future financing proceeds applies. This is a routine financing obligation, not a special situation.
